steps.title: The year's concert
steps.body:
Four seasons end here. They covered scales, pedalling, ear playing, fingering, tempo, phrasing, rhythm, sections, articulation, composing, strangers, chords, improvising, accompanying, a hard piece, nerves, and honest speed.

1. Choose two pieces from the programme, say the names, play them, hold the last note of the second, and bow.
2. Teach someone younger a short tune. Show it slowly, let them try, fix one thing, let them try again.
3. The family asks one question. Answer it.

Then write the long version of the Practice log. Say which trick from this whole year helped the most, and which piece you would still want to play in a year.

A year of sittings, seasons apart, ends the way every season has ended. You play for the people around you, and hand what you learned to someone smaller.

The family asked one question, and you answered it

steps.title: Record the recital
steps.prompt: Record the recital in one take: both pieces from the programme, names said, hands in the frame. If the lesson went well, add a second clip of the tune being taught.
